camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeCdnDomainByCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --SSLStatus true --SSLPub 000000 --Exact true
description_en: Queries accelerated domain names by SSL certificate
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDomainByCertificate根据证书信息获取加速域名
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-cdn-domain-by-certificate --ssl-pub 000000 --ssl-status true --exact true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnDomainByCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The public key of the SSL certificate. You must encode the public key in Base64 and then call the encodeURIComponent function to encode the public key again.

The public key must be in the PEM format
parameters.help_zh:
证书公钥，需要base64编码后再进行encodeURIComponent。

支持pem格式
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the domain name list to return contains only domain names with HTTPS enabled or disabled.

true: The domain name list contains only domain names with HTTPS enabled.

false: The domain name list contains only domain names with HTTPS disabled
parameters.help_zh:
表示返回的域名列表只包含开启或关闭HTTPS的域名。

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the domain name list to return match the SSL certificate.

true: The domain name list match the SSL certificate.

false: The domain name list do not match the SSL certificate
parameters.help_zh:
表示返回的域名列表是否与证书精准匹配。
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: exact

CertCaIsLegacy.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate is obsolete. Valid values:

yes: The SSL certificate is obsolete.

no: The SSL certificate is working as expected
CertCaIsLegacy.description_zh:
证书CA废弃状态。取值：

yes：已废弃。

no：正常，未废弃

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate

CertExpired.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate is expired. Valid values:

yes: The SSL certificate is expired.

no: The SSL certificate is not expired
CertExpired.description_zh:
证书过期状态。 取值：

yes：已过期。

no：未过期

CertStartTime.description_en: The time when the certificate became effective

CertSubjectCommonName.description_en: The name of the SSL certificate owner

CertType.description_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: RSA, DSA, and ECDSA

DomainList.description_en: If a value is returned, the value matches the SSL certificate. Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
DomainList.description_zh: 如果该返回值不为空，则将该列表与证书做匹配，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔

DomainNames.description_en: The domain names (DNS fields) that match the SSL certificate. Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
DomainNames.description_zh: 证书匹配的域名（DNS字段），多个用英文逗号（,）分隔

Issuer.description_en: The certificate authority (CA) that issued the certificate
Issuer.example: C=US, O=Symantec Corporation, OU=Symantec Trust Network, OU=Domain Validated SSL, CN=Symantec Basic DV SSL CA - G1
